CheckTitle: EC2 instance requires IMDSv2 for the custom baseline
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: **EC2 instances** must require **IMDSv2** tokens or disable the instance metadata service.
Risk: IMDSv1 permits request forgery attacks to retrieve temporary role credentials, which can enable **privilege escalation**, data access and lateral movement.

Code.Other: Set Instance metadata service to IMDSv2 only in the EC2 instance metadata options.

Recommendation.Text: Require IMDSv2 on all instances, disable metadata where it is not needed and keep instance-profile permissions least-privileged.

Notes: Example check from the Prowler custom checks plug-in.
